title: Leaving your desk? Lock your screen in 1 second! 🔒⚡ #Shorts
description:
Stepping away from your computer? Lock your screen instantly so nobody can peek at your files! 🙌

⌨️ Windows: Win + L
🍎 Mac: Ctrl + Cmd + Q (or Cmd + Control + Q)

Tip: you'll need your password or PIN to unlock it, so your work stays safe and private.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
